Title: Island Taxi
Description: Dial 555-TAXI1 from any phone to call a taxi: pick a vehicle, drop a map pin, and an NPC chauffeur flies, sails or drives you there. Fares are paid up front in scrap and scale with distance.

Commands.Description: Cancel your booking or current ride

HowTo: Use any pay phone or a mobile phone and dial 55582941 — listed as Island Taxi in the directory.
Pick a vehicle from the menu; each shows its terrain, fare and speed.
Open your map and drop a marker on your destination, then confirm the quote.
Wait where you are — the taxi arrives from off the map. Press E on a passenger seat to board.
Ride to the drop-off; the driver leaves on his own. /taxi cancel bails out any time.
Notes: The fleet: Minicopter, Attack Heli and Scrap Heli fly anywhere; Car, Armored Car and Motorcycle serve the roads; the Boat works the coast and rivers; the Horse goes cross-country.
Dedicated stops: heli pads at Outpost, Bandit Camp, Radtown, the Apartment Complex roof and both Oil Rigs — plus boat docks at both rigs. Anywhere else, the taxi finds a safe spot near your pin.
No refunds once the taxi has spawned.
Teammates standing near you board too on team vehicles like the Scrap Heli.
